entries.name: branding
entries.content: Creative and branding record for Brightside Fixtures. The Fall Warm-Up Sale runs Sep 15-30, in store and online. Brand guide bg_7c1f is the single source for color and type; the house pairing for sale creative is the cream #F5EFE4 on the navy #1F3A5F. Storyboard ledger, recorded at submit time because spend is tracked here: 2026-08-27 sb_fall_teaser, Fall Warm-Up teaser, six scenes, est $5.40, submitted for approval and NOT approved yet; 2026-08-19 sb_summer_recap, Summer clearance recap, five scenes, est $4.10, approved the same day, run completed, result registered as ast_509. Spend ledger: August AI clips used 3 of 20; voiceover seconds used 0. Standing practice: register every design export before attaching it anywhere, and archive designs (status 'archived') rather than expecting a delete tool - none exists.
